en.title: Jr. Frontend Developer

items: Built websites, landing pages, e-commerce stores and back-office systems for the agency's clients.

Worked with HTML/CSS, JavaScript, jQuery and React on the frontend, and PHP, Node.js, MySQL and WordPress on the backend.
